english.title: Deposit a builder's skip on a highway without authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), was the owner of a builder's skip that had been deposited on a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY THE HIGHWAY..), without a permission granted under section 139 of the Highways Act 1980
english.legislation: Contrary to section 139(3) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes: Subsections 139(6) to (10) of the Highways Act 1980 provides defences which are available to persons contravening the controls which are placed on the depositing of builders skips on the highway.
